hospitality.label: Hospitality

seo.title: IT support for hospitality | Fox ITC
seo.description: Guest Wi-Fi, EPOS uptime, venue networking, connectivity and cyber security for pubs, restaurants, hotels and venues — with a real person on the end of the phone.

hero.h1: Technology that keeps your venue running — and your guests happy.
hero.p: From guest Wi-Fi and EPOS uptime to the network behind it all, we keep hospitality businesses connected, secure and supported.

hospitality.intro: Busy venues can't wait for IT. We provide the managed support, networking and security your day-to-day systems rely on — explained in plain English, backed by a friendly UK team.

modules.challenge: When the EPOS or card machine goes down, service stops.
modules.solution: Fast, managed IT support that gets your tills, payments and systems back up quickly.

modules.challenge: Guests expect fast, reliable Wi-Fi the moment they sit down.
modules.solution: Guest Wi-Fi built for busy venues — a separate, secure network, surveyed for full coverage.

modules.challenge: Multiple sites and a patchy connection make everything harder.
modules.solution: Business connectivity — leased lines and broadband — to keep every site online.

modules.challenge: Card data and bookings are a target for cyber attacks.
modules.solution: Security-first protection and training, with ISO 27001 as the benchmark.

modules.challenge: Email, rotas and documents are scattered across devices.
modules.solution: Microsoft 365 set up right — email, files and Teams, secured.

faqs.q: Do you support EPOS and payment systems?
faqs.a: We provide the managed IT, networking and connectivity your EPOS and card systems rely on, and we're here when something goes wrong. We don't replace your EPOS provider — we keep the infrastructure around it reliable.

faqs.q: Can you set up a separate guest Wi-Fi?
faqs.a: Yes. A separate, secure guest network — surveyed and designed for your venue — is part of our WiFi service.

faqs.q: Are we tied to one broadband provider?
faqs.a: No. We're independent and source the right connectivity for each site.

cta.h: Let's talk about your venue's IT.
cta.p: Book a free, no-obligation 15-minute review and we'll show you where you can save and simplify.

Resilient connectivity — leased lines and broadband — to keep operations online.

modules.challenge: Logistics is a growing cyber-attack target.
modules.solution: Security-first protection, monitoring and training, ISO 27001 as the benchmark.

modules.challenge: Drivers and depots need the same tools everywhere.
modules.solution: Microsoft 365 and business mobile, set up and secured for a mobile workforce.
